results.content:
For some reason, I thought the Julie Mehretu paintings that currently flank the main staircase inside SFMOMA’s Third Street entrance were a permanent fixture. Not so! Sarah Sze, known for her dazzling, complex installations of small, colorful objects, has been commissioned to create a new piece for the atrium. ## Other things to look forward to this fall

September: Masaki Fujihata’s BeHere / 1942: A New Lens on the Japanese American Incarceration at OMCA; Dorian Reid’s Calling All Cats! at MoAD; the group exhibition I see every wave at the Berkeley Art Center; Greg Ito’s solo show at the ICA San José.

October: an unobstructed view of the Ferry Building, when the giant lady is finally deinstalled; Leila Weefur’s The Chapel of Becoming at the Lab.
